text: 瑞银集团首席执行官Sergio Ermotti在接受采访时表示，他预计今年剩余时间里“波动性飙升”还将继续。“从宏观形势、地缘政治局势、当前的争论，以及我们在股市中看到的巨大分化来看，能源价格面临的压力可能会给通胀带来潜在的逆风”。Ermotti表示投资者不会喜欢这种波动，“我确实预计在今年剩余时间里波动性将继续飙升”。
text_en: UBS CEO Sergio Ermotti said in an interview that he expects 'volatility spikes' to continue for the rest of the year. 'From the macro situation, geopolitical tensions, current debates, and the massive divergence we're seeing in the stock market, pressures on energy prices could create potential headwinds for inflation.' Ermotti added that investors will not like this volatility, stating, 'I do expect volatility to continue spiking for the rest of the year.'
